phases.name: The Wheel Spins Back
phases.say: (The shell turns the other way, and the last few moments happen again.)

say.open: (A snail the size of a cart. Its shell is a clock, and the hands are moving.)
say.death: (The hands stop. Somewhere, a moment finally ends.)

bestiary.lore: The card of fortune and turning: a snail from beyond the rift whose shell keeps the time, and bends it.
bestiary.weakness: Holy. Dispel its haste, and spread out against the slime.
bestiary.pattern: Every third turn the wheel turns on everyone, slowing and sometimes Stopping; every fourth it hastens and shields itself; slime roots a row between. At half the wheel turns every other turn.
